text: City Council at its January 30 and 31, 2019 meeting, adopted as amended Item CA2.2. City Council appointed seven public members to the Toronto Public Library Board. As a result of a candidate withdrawal, one vacancy on the Board still remains. City Council has requested the Civic Appointments Committee to give consideration to a vacancy on the Toronto Public Library Board at its earliest opportunity.
The Civic Appointments Committee: 1. Selected the following candidates to be re-interviewed for appointment to the Toronto Public Library Board: Candidate #1-640 Candidate #1-686 Candidate #2-135
